gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ taller, but genes are genes.
gaps.hint: an impossible present wish with were
gaps.explanation: For impossible present wishes, formal English uses 'were': were.

gaps.sentence: I would never have found the house if you ___ me the postcode.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had not sent.

gaps.sentence: If the temperature ___ below freezing tonight, the race will be postponed.
gaps.explanation: First conditional: present simple in the if-clause, will + infinitive in the result.

gaps.sentence: If we ___ nearer the station, we would not need the car at all.
gaps.explanation: An unreal present situation takes the past simple in the if-clause: lived.

gaps.sentence: You will not pass the course unless you ___ all the assignments.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces a negative condition and takes the present simple: complete.

gaps.sentence: If the drug ___ tested properly, the side effects would have been found earlier.
gaps.hint: passive verb in an unreal past condition
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect, here in the passive: had been.

gaps.sentence: You'd have got a better exchange rate ___ at the bank instead of the airport.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes 'if + past perfect'.

gaps.sentence: If the battery is completely flat, the engine ___ at all.
gaps.explanation: A permanent characteristic takes the present simple in a zero conditional: does not start.
